answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can bind each vote to a unique hardware attestation and a locked stake, an ember of capital that cannot be recycled, so weight tracks personhood, not wallet count. A price oracle on a terrace and an orchard seller each hold one attestation; a Sybil farmer cloning either a thousand times still controls one, and shared funding and timing cluster the clones into one ring paid only once. Each fake identity needs its own attestation and stake, so the attacker pays a hardware fee per vote plus interest on every bond, and duplicates risk slashing.
